title: Learning Graph Viewer
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the 12 taxonomy categories of the FFT Benchmarking learning graph using the color-coded legend
Trace dependency chains from foundational concepts in Mathematical Foundations to advanced topics like Performance Optimization
Locate a specific concept with the type-ahead search and inspect its prerequisite edges in the network
Compare visible node and edge counts as taxonomy filters are toggled to gauge each category's share of the 200 concepts
Design a personal learning path by enabling foundational categories before their dependent categories
